pages.text: [#](53341a)A small working that tears open the ground beyond the circle — rough, practical witchcraft for a trench, a hazard, or a sudden gap where there was solid ground.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Broken Earth

pages.text: [#](53341a)Offer a **Brew of Erosion** on a small circle; the crevice carves ahead of the casting point, so choose your direction first.[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)Use it to disrupt pursuers, split a battlefield, or make a sudden barrier. Blunt magic — effective, noisy, and inclined to ruin the ground.[#]()
